rubrics.title: Capstone data story — holistic rubric

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Insight is vague or not tied to the dataset.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One clear insight with plausible support from the data.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Insight is specific, decision-ready, and acknowledges uncertainty.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Charts are readable and mostly honest.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Charts follow accessibility and scale best practices.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: No mention of limitations or privacy.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: States at least one limitation or bias risk.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Explicit limitations, audience fit, and safe-use notes.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: Action is missing or unrelated to insight.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Action aligns with insight and scope.

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Action includes owner, metric, and review trigger.

rubrics.exemplarNotes: Link instructor-facing exemplar: strong capstone uses BLUF headline and a single guardrail metric.
